summary: Every course must be taken for a letter grade, and the audit counts your courses toward the 64 units the major needs. Foundations takes one of its two courses, Breadth three courses and 15 units, and Depth five courses and 15 units in one cluster; the Science, Technology & Society cluster lists only four courses, so you move in its last two (the fourth listed course, or courses from another department the DUS approves). Community Engaged Learning is AFRICAAM 212 or 214, or a listed overseas course plus a 2-unit re-entry directed reading you move in. AFRICAAM 200X counts as both WIM and capstone. The senior presentation, and for honors the thesis graded A, the 3.5 GPA and the presentation, are checked by hand. The honors courses AFRICAAM 200Y and 200Z do not count toward the 64 units.
